518	-- 8a. check_low_stock
519	-- Fires AFTER INSERT on inventory_movements.
520	-- 1. Updates inventory_items.current_stock += qty_delta.
521	-- 2. If new stock <= min_stock_threshold, upserts a stock_alert.
522	--    Uses SECURITY DEFINER so it can write to stock_alerts without
523	--    a direct INSERT policy for app roles.
524	-- ------------------------------------------------------------
525	
526	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_check_low_stock()
527	RETURNS TRIGGER
528	LANGUAGE plpgsql
529	SECURITY DEFINER
530	SET search_path = public
531	AS $$
532	DECLARE
533	  v_new_stock   NUMERIC(10,2);
534	  v_threshold   NUMERIC(10,2);
535	  v_studio_id   UUID;
536	  v_alert_type  TEXT;
537	BEGIN
538	  -- 1. Update current_stock on the item
539	  UPDATE public.inventory_items
540	     SET current_stock   = current_stock + NEW.qty_delta,
541	         last_counted_at = CASE WHEN NEW.reason = 'stocktake' THEN now() ELSE last_counted_at END
542	   WHERE id = NEW.item_id
543	  RETURNING current_stock, min_stock_threshold, studio_id
544	    INTO v_new_stock, v_threshold, v_studio_id;
545	
546	  -- 2. Evaluate alert threshold
547	  IF v_new_stock <= v_threshold THEN
548	    v_alert_type := CASE WHEN v_new_stock <= 0 THEN 'out_of_stock' ELSE 'low_stock' END;
549	
550	    -- Upsert: insert new alert or update existing unacknowledged alert.
551	    -- Uses partial unique index (item_id, alert_type) WHERE acknowledged_at IS NULL.
552	    -- Redefined in Section 12 as idx_stock_alerts_open_alert.
553	    INSERT INTO public.stock_alerts
554	      (studio_id, item_id, alert_type, current_stock, threshold)
555	    VALUES
556	      (v_studio_id, NEW.item_id, v_alert_type, v_new_stock, v_threshold)
557	    ON CONFLICT (item_id, alert_type) WHERE (acknowledged_at IS NULL)
558	    DO UPDATE
559	       SET current_stock = EXCLUDED.current_stock,
560	           alert_type    = EXCLUDED.alert_type,
561	           updated_at    = now();
562	  END IF;
563	
564	  RETURN NEW;
565	END;
566	$$;

102	export async function handleProcessAiDesign({ requestId, studioId }: ProcessAiDesignJobData): Promise<void> {
103	  const log = logger.child({ handler: 'process-ai-design', requestId, studioId })
104	  log.info('starting AI design pipeline')
105	
106	  const supabase = getServiceRoleClient()
107	
108	  // --- Fetch request row ---
109	  const { data: request, error: reqErr } = await supabase
110	    .from('ai_design_requests')
111	    .select('*')
112	    .eq('id', requestId)
113	    .single()
114	
115	  if (reqErr || !request) {
116	    log.error({ err: reqErr }, 'request not found')
117	    throw new Error(`ai_design_request not found: ${requestId}`)
118	  }
119	
120	  const req = request as unknown as AiDesignRequestRow
121	
122	  if (req.status === 'cancelled') {
123	    log.info('request was cancelled — skipping')
124	    return
125	  }
126	
127	  // Mark as processing
128	  await supabase
129	    .from('ai_design_requests')
130	    .update({ status: 'processing', processing_started_at: new Date().toISOString() })
131	    .eq('id', requestId)
132	
133	  // Count existing outputs for sequence numbering
134	  const { count: existingCount } = await supabase
135	    .from('ai_design_outputs')
136	    .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
137	    .eq('request_id', requestId)
138	
139	  let nextSequence = (existingCount ?? 0) + 1
140	
141	  try {
142	    // --- Step 1: Fetch best matching prompt template ---
143	    const { data: templates } = await supabase
144	      .from('ai_design_templates')
145	      .select('id, system_prompt, user_prompt_template, image_prompt_template')
146	      .or(`studio_id.eq.${studioId},studio_id.is.null`)
147	      .eq('style_category', req.style_category)
148	      .eq('is_active', true)
149	      .order('studio_id', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false }) // studio custom first
150	      .limit(1)
151	
152	    const template = templates?.[0] as AiDesignTemplateRow | undefined
153	
154	    if (!template) {
155	      throw new Error(`No active template found for style: ${req.style_category}`)
156	    }
157	
158	    // --- Step 2: Anthropic Claude analysis ---
159	    const anthropicKey = process.env['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY']
160	    if (!anthropicKey) throw new Error('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not configured')
161	
162	    const anthropic = new Anthropic({ apiKey: anthropicKey })
163	
164	    const ctx: Record<string, string> = {
165	      description: req.description,
166	      style: req.style_category,
167	      body_area: req.body_area ?? 'Not specified',
168	      size_estimate: req.size_estimate ?? 'Not specified',
169	      mood_keywords: req.mood_keywords?.join(', ') ?? 'None',
170	      avoid_keywords: req.avoid_keywords?.join(', ') ?? 'None',
171	    }
172	
173	    const userPrompt = hydratePrompt(template.user_prompt_template, ctx)
174	
175	    // Build message content — include reference images if any
176	    type ContentBlock =
177	      | { type: 'text'; text: string }
178	      | { type: 'image'; source: { type: 'url'; url: string } }
179	
180	    const contentBlocks: ContentBlock[] = [{ type: 'text', text: userPrompt }]
181	
182	    if (req.reference_image_urls && req.reference_image_urls.length > 0) {
183	      for (const imgUrl of req.reference_image_urls.slice(0, 5)) {
184	        contentBlocks.push({
185	          type: 'image',
186	          source: { type: 'url', url: imgUrl },
187	        })
188	      }
189	    }
190	
191	    log.info({ promptLength: userPrompt.length, hasImages: contentBlocks.length > 1 }, 'calling Claude API')
192	    const claudeStart = Date.now()
193	
194	    let claudeResponse: Anthropic.Message
195	    try {
196	      claudeResponse = await anthropic.messages.create({
197	        model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
198	        max_tokens: 2048,
199	        system: template.system_prompt,
200	        messages: [
201	          {
202	            role: 'user',
203	            content: contentBlocks as Anthropic.MessageParam['content'],
204	          },
205	        ],
206	      })
207	    } catch (claudeErr) {
208	      // Retry once on timeout/server error
209	      if (claudeErr instanceof Anthropic.APIError && claudeErr.status >= 500) {
210	        log.warn({ err: claudeErr }, 'Claude API error — retrying once')
211	        claudeResponse = await anthropic.messages.create({
212	          model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
213	          max_tokens: 2048,
214	          system: template.system_prompt,
215	          messages: [{ role: 'user', content: contentBlocks as Anthropic.MessageParam['content'] }],
216	        })
217	      } else {
218	        throw claudeErr
219	      }
220	    }
221	
222	    const claudeDurationMs = Date.now() - claudeStart
223	    const claudeInputTokens = claudeResponse.usage.input_tokens
224	    const claudeOutputTokens = claudeResponse.usage.output_tokens
225	    const claudeCost = claudeCostCents(claudeInputTokens, claudeOutputTokens)
226	
227	    const responseText = claudeResponse.content
228	      .filter((b): b is Anthropic.TextBlock => b.type === 'text')
229	      .map((b) => b.text)
230	      .join('\n\n')
231	
232	    log.info({ tokensIn: claudeInputTokens, tokensOut: claudeOutputTokens, costCents: claudeCost }, 'Claude analysis complete')
233	
234	    // Insert text output
235	    const { data: textOutput, error: textInsertErr } = await supabase
236	      .from('ai_design_outputs')
237	      .insert({
238	        studio_id: studioId,
239	        request_id: requestId,
240	        sequence: nextSequence,
241	        prompt_text: userPrompt,
242	        system_prompt: template.system_prompt,
243	        model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
244	        response_text: responseText,
245	        tokens_input: claudeInputTokens,
246	        tokens_output: claudeOutputTokens,
247	        cost_cents: claudeCost,
248	        generation_time_ms: claudeDurationMs,
249	        status: 'completed',
250	      })
251	      .select('id')
252	      .single()
253	
254	    if (textInsertErr || !textOutput) {
255	      log.error({ err: textInsertErr }, 'failed to insert text output')
256	      throw textInsertErr ?? new Error('text output insert returned null')
257	    }
258	
259	    // Log Claude usage
260	    await supabase.from('ai_usage_log').insert({
261	      studio_id: studioId,
262	      request_id: requestId,
263	      output_id: textOutput.id,
264	      api_provider: 'anthropic',
265	      model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
266	      endpoint: 'messages',
267	      tokens_input: claudeInputTokens,
268	      tokens_output: claudeOutputTokens,
269	      cost_cents: claudeCost,
270	      duration_ms: claudeDurationMs,
271	      http_status: 200,
272	    })
273	
274	    nextSequence++
275	
276	    // --- Step 3: Image generation ---
277	    const imageProvider = (process.env['AI_IMAGE_PROVIDER'] ?? 'openai') as 'openai' | 'stability'
278	    const openaiKey = process.env['OPENAI_API_KEY']
279	
280	    if (imageProvider === 'openai' && openaiKey) {
281	      const imagePromptText = buildImagePrompt(responseText.slice(0, 1000), req.style_category, req.body_area)
282	      const imagePromptFinal = template.image_prompt_template
283	        ? hydratePrompt(template.image_prompt_template, { ...ctx, description: imagePromptText })
284	        : imagePromptText
285	
286	      log.info({ provider: 'openai', promptLength: imagePromptFinal.length }, 'calling DALL-E 3')
287	      const imageStart = Date.now()
288	
289	      const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: openaiKey })
290	      const imageResponse = await openai.images.generate({
291	        model: 'dall-e-3',
292	        prompt: imagePromptFinal.slice(0, 4000), // DALL-E 3 limit
293	        size: '1024x1024',
294	        quality: 'hd',
295	        n: 1,
296	      })
297	
298	      const imageDurationMs = Date.now() - imageStart
299	      const imageUrl = imageResponse.data?.[0]?.url
300	
301	      if (!imageUrl) throw new Error('DALL-E 3 returned no image URL')
302	
303	      // Download image and upload to Supabase Storage
304	      const imageBuffer = await fetch(imageUrl).then((r) => r.arrayBuffer())
305	      const storagePath = `${studioId}/ai/${requestId}/${nextSequence}.png`
306	
307	      const { error: uploadErr } = await supabase
308	        .storage
309	        .from('design-assets')
310	        .upload(storagePath, Buffer.from(imageBuffer), {
311	          contentType: 'image/png',
312	          upsert: true,
313	        })
314	
315	      if (uploadErr) {
316	        log.error({ err: uploadErr, storagePath }, 'image upload failed')
317	        throw uploadErr
318	      }
319	
320	      const { data: publicUrlData } = supabase
321	        .storage
322	        .from('design-assets')
323	        .getPublicUrl(storagePath)
324	
325	      const { data: imageOutput, error: imageInsertErr } = await supabase
326	        .from('ai_design_outputs')
327	        .insert({
328	          studio_id: studioId,
329	          request_id: requestId,
330	          sequence: nextSequence,
331	          prompt_text: imagePromptFinal,
332	          model: 'dall-e-3',
333	          image_url: publicUrlData?.publicUrl ?? storagePath,
334	          image_model: 'dall-e-3',
335	          image_prompt: imagePromptFinal,
336	          tokens_input: 0,
337	          tokens_output: 0,
338	          cost_cents: DALLE3_HD_COST_CENTS,
339	          generation_time_ms: imageDurationMs,
340	          status: 'completed',
341	        })
342	        .select('id')
343	        .single()
344	
345	      if (imageInsertErr || !imageOutput) {
346	        log.error({ err: imageInsertErr }, 'failed to insert image output')
347	      } else {
348	        // Log image gen usage
349	        await supabase.from('ai_usage_log').insert({
350	          studio_id: studioId,
351	          request_id: requestId,
352	          output_id: imageOutput.id,
353	          api_provider: 'openai',
354	          model: 'dall-e-3',
355	          endpoint: 'images.generate',
356	          tokens_input: 0,
357	          tokens_output: 0,
358	          cost_cents: DALLE3_HD_COST_CENTS,
359	          duration_ms: imageDurationMs,
360	          http_status: 200,
361	        })
362	      }
363	
364	      log.info({ durationMs: imageDurationMs, storagePath }, 'image generation complete')
365	    } else {
366	      log.info('image generation skipped — no image provider API key configured')
367	    }
368	
369	    // The trigger handle_ai_output_request_completion will set request status = 'completed'
370	    log.info('AI design pipeline complete')

16	  access_token: string
17	  refresh_token?: string
18	  expires_in: number
19	  token_type: string
20	}
21	
22	function isValidState(value: unknown): value is OAuthState {
23	  return (
24	    typeof value === 'object' &&
25	    value !== null &&
26	    'artist_id' in value &&
27	    'studio_id' in value &&
28	    'sync_direction' in value &&
29	    'user_id' in value &&
30	    'ts' in value
31	  )
32	}
33	
34	function isTokenResponse(value: unknown): value is GoogleTokenResponse {
35	  return (
36	    typeof value === 'object' &&
37	    value !== null &&
38	    'access_token' in value &&
39	    typeof (value as Record<string, unknown>).access_token === 'string'
40	  )
41	}

43	export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
44	  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
45	  const code = searchParams.get('code')
46	  const stateRaw = searchParams.get('state')
47	  const error = searchParams.get('error')
48	
49	  const appUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ?? ''
50	
51	  if (error) {
52	    logger.warn({ error }, 'Google OAuth denied by user')
53	    return NextResponse.redirect(`${appUrl}/settings/integrations?cal_error=denied`)
54	  }
55	
56	  if (!code || !stateRaw) {
57	    return NextResponse.redirect(`${appUrl}/settings/integrations?cal_error=missing_params`)
58	  }
59	
60	  let state: OAuthState
61	  try {
62	    const decoded = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(stateRaw, 'base64url').toString('utf-8'))
63	    if (!isValidState(decoded)) throw new Error('invalid shape')
64	    // Reject states older than 10 minutes
65	    if (Date.now() - decoded.ts > 10 * 60 * 1000) throw new Error('expired')
66	    state = decoded
67	  } catch {
68	    return NextResponse.redirect(`${appUrl}/settings/integrations?cal_error=invalid_state`)
69	  }
70	
71	  try {
72	    const clientId = process.env.GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID!
73	    const clientSecret = process.env.GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET!
74	    const redirectUri = `${appUrl}/api/integrations/google-calendar/callback`
75	
76	    const tokenRes = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
77	      method: 'POST',
78	      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
79	      body: new URLSearchParams({
80	        client_id: clientId,
81	        client_secret: clientSecret,
82	        redirect_uri: redirectUri,
83	        grant_type: 'authorization_code',
84	        code,
85	      }),
86	    })
87	
88	    const tokenData: unknown = await tokenRes.json()
89	    if (!tokenRes.ok || !isTokenResponse(tokenData)) {
90	      logger.error({ status: tokenRes.status, tokenData }, 'google token exchange failed')
91	      return NextResponse.redirect(`${appUrl}/settings/integrations?cal_error=token_exchange`)
92	    }
93	
94	    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + tokenData.expires_in * 1000).toISOString()
95	
96	    // Use service role to store encrypted tokens
97	    const supabase = createServiceRoleClient()
98	
99	    // Tokens stored encrypted via pgcrypto via RPC — never in plaintext
100	    const { error: upsertError } = await supabase.rpc('store_calendar_tokens', {
101	      p_studio_id: state.studio_id,
102	      p_artist_id: state.artist_id,
103	      p_provider: 'google',
104	      p_sync_direction: state.sync_direction,
105	      p_access_token: tokenData.access_token,
106	      p_refresh_token: tokenData.refresh_token ?? null,
107	      p_token_expires_at: expiresAt,
108	    })
109	
110	    if (upsertError) {
111	      logger.error({ err: upsertError, artistId: state.artist_id }, 'store_calendar_tokens failed')
112	      return NextResponse.redirect(`${appUrl}/settings/integrations?cal_error=store_failed`)
113	    }
114	
115	    await logAuditAction(
116	      state.user_id,
117	      'integration.google_calendar.connect',
118	      { type: 'artist', id: state.artist_id },
119	      { sync_direction: state.sync_direction },
120	      state.studio_id,
121	    )
122	
123	    return NextResponse.redirect(`${appUrl}/settings/integrations?cal_success=1`)
124	  } catch (err) {
125	    logger.error({ err }, 'google calendar callback unexpected error')
126	    return NextResponse.redirect(`${appUrl}/settings/integrations?cal_error=server`)
127	  }
128	}
